exams.name: Property and Casualty Insurance Agent Examination
exams.notes: Required for resident property and casualty insurance agent and personal lines agent licenses. Applicants who fail three times must wait 30 calendar days before retaking.
exams.quote: No individual who is a resident of this Commonwealth shall obtain a license as a property and casualty insurance agent or as a personal lines agent from the Commission unless he has passed an examination in a form and manner prescribed by the Commission.

exams.name: Life and Annuities Insurance Agent Examination
exams.notes: Required for resident life and annuities agent license. Commission annually reviews whether pass rate is consistent with 2013 NAIC State Licensing Handbook.
exams.quote: No individual who is a resident of the Commonwealth shall obtain a license as a life and annuities agent from the Commission unless the individual has passed an examination in a form and manner prescribed by the Commission.

exams.name: Health Agent Examination
exams.notes: Required for resident health agent license.
exams.quote: No individual who is a resident of this Commonwealth shall obtain a license as a health agent from the Commission unless he has passed an examination in a form and manner prescribed by the Commission.

exams.name: Financial Industry Regulatory Authority (FINRA) Examination
exams.notes: Required for variable contract agent license, in addition to holding a life and annuities license.
exams.quote: no individual, whether resident or nonresident, shall obtain a license as a variable contract agent unless the individual has passed the Financial Industry Regulatory Authority examination or examinations prescribed by the Commission or such other examination prescribed by the Commission.

interval_years.quote: each individual agent shall submit biennially to the Commission a renewal application in a form and manner prescribed by the Commission, along with a nonrefundable renewal application processing fee prescribed by the Commission, for the renewal of the license.

required.quote: Every individual resident and nonresident (i) insurance consultant, (ii) life and annuities insurance agent, (iii) health agent, (iv) property and casualty insurance agent (v) personal lines agent, and (vi) title insurance agent shall, on a biennial basis, furnish evidence as set forth in this article that the continuing education requirements of this article have been satisfied.

hours_per_period.quote: Any agent who holds a life and annuities license or a health agent license, or both, shall complete 16 hours of relevant continuing education credits.

period_years.quote: Every individual resident and nonresident (i) insurance consultant, (ii) life and annuities insurance agent, (iii) health agent, (iv) property and casualty insurance agent (v) personal lines agent, and (vi) title insurance agent shall, on a biennial basis, furnish evidence as set forth in this article that the continuing education requirements of this article have been satisfied.

definition_quote.value: Agent, insurance agent, producer, or insurance producer, when used without qualification, means an individual or business entity that sells, solicits, or negotiates contracts of insurance or annuity in the Commonwealth.
definition_quote.quote: "Agent," "insurance agent," "producer," or "insurance producer," when used without qualification, means an individual or business entity that sells, solicits, or negotiates contracts of insurance or annuity in the Commonwealth.

methods_authorized.quote: "Sell" means to exchange a contract of insurance by any means, for money or its equivalent, on behalf of an insurer. "Solicit" means attempting to sell insurance or asking or urging a person to apply for a particular class of insurance from one or more insurers. "Negotiate" means the act of conferring directly with or offering advice directly to a purchaser or prospective purchaser of a particular contract of insurance concerning any of the substantive benefits, terms or conditions of the contract

preexamination_education_hours.quote: Before registering to take an examination for a license as a title insurance agent, each applicant shall have completed, within the period specified in subsection B, a pre-licensing education course of 16 hours of instruction.

exam_waiver_designations.quote: An individual who applies for a resident insurance agent's license in the Commonwealth who was previously licensed for the same lines of authority in the individual's home state shall not be required to complete any prelicensing examination.

business_entity_license_available.quote: A business entity acting as an insurance producer is required to obtain an insurance producer license.

designated_licensee_required_for_busines.quote: The business entity has designated an employee, officer, director, manager, member, or partner to serve as the licensed producer responsible for the business entity's compliance with the insurance laws, rules, and regulations of the Commonwealth.

temporary_license_available.quote: Temporary individual licenses providing for life and health insurance authority or property and casualty insurance authority shall be issued by the Commission in the following circumstances:

temporary_license_max_days.quote: Only one temporary life and health license and one temporary property and casualty license may be issued to any individual during his lifetime, and each such temporary license shall be valid for a period of 180 calendar days.

appointment_required_to_represent_insure.quote: No insurer shall pay directly or indirectly any commission or other valuable consideration to any person for services as an agent or a surplus lines broker within this Commonwealth unless the person is then a duly appointed agent of such insurer

appointment_fee.value: Not less than $7 nor more than $25 per appointment notification; annual renewal appointment fee also required per appointment
appointment_fee.quote: The prescribed appointment fee shall not be less than $7 nor more than $25.

appointment_termination_reporting_days.quote: the insurer or authorized representative shall certify in writing to the Commission within 30 calendar days following the termination the reason for such termination.

fiduciary_duty_for_funds.quote: All premiums, return premiums, or other funds received in any manner by an agent or a surplus lines broker shall be held in a fiduciary capacity and shall be accounted for by such agent or surplus lines broker.

additional_fee_for_commercial_business_a.quote: no agent shall charge, or demand or receive from, an applicant for insurance or a policyholder any consideration in return for rendering services associated with a contract of insurance, when the consideration is in addition to the premium for such contract, unless: 1. The applicant or policyholder consents in writing before any services are rendered.

misconduct_reporting_to_department_days.quote: Each licensed agent shall report to the Commission within 30 calendar days of the final disposition of the matter any administrative action taken against him in another jurisdiction or by another governmental agency in the Commonwealth.

naic_producer_database_used_for_verifica.quote: The Commission may verify the agent's licensing status through the Producer Database maintained by the NAIC, its affiliates or subsidiaries.

home_state_change_application_window_day.quote: An individual licensed as an insurance producer in another state or province of Canada, but not holding a nonresident Virginia agent license, who moves to this Commonwealth shall submit the application to become a resident licensee and shall pay the license processing fee required by § 38.2-1819 and in accordance with the requirements of § 38.2-1836 within ninety calendar days of establishing legal residence in this Commonwealth.

lapsed_license_reinstatement_window_days.quote: An individual agent whose license terminates due to failure to renew may, within 12 months from the renewal date, reinstate the same license without the necessity of passing a prelicensing written examination

fingerprint_submission_required.quote: Each individual who is a resident of the Commonwealth shall, at the time of applying for a new license, be fingerprinted in a form and manner prescribed by the Commission and shall provide personal descriptive information to be forwarded along with the applicant's fingerprints through the Central Criminal Records Exchange to the Federal Bureau of Investigation for the purpose of obtaining criminal history record information regarding such applicant.
